europe_now.title: French government promises €1B for drought-stricken farmers
europe_now.summary: The French government has pledged one billion euros in financial aid to farmers recovering from a summer severely impacted by drought and heatwaves. This support aims to address the significant economic losses caused by the adverse weather conditions.

sources.headline: French government promises €1B for drought-stricken farmers
